known_approximations: Stone colors and microsurface are photographic estimates, not measured spectrophotometric albedo or exact quarry scans.
Window-bay metric dimensions and individual opening layout are approximate; shapes use photo-derived architectural vocabulary.
No artist inscriptions or saint names are invented as readable panel text.
Apse and central clerestory patterns remain original interpretations pending more identifiable sources.

West red/orange/green relative sequence confirmed against Bracons2015 and Smiley2023 photographs. Absolute bay indices are approximate. Each source bank is also reused at the upper side-wall level because an exact upper inventory is not available.

Smiley2023 green bank: bottom edges of several source panes are partly cropped; visitor cord and photograph shadows cross parts of the bottom register. Those observed source pixels are retained; unseen artwork is not fabricated.

The Alikhan2022 red-bank rose is occluded by the gallery in that image. Its entire flower is mapped from a matching Mortel2016 photograph, identified by the Lujan/Copecabana/Maria Congo oculi and distinctive blue glass at the base of the left register.
Ruled spandrel folds and stepped stone reveals use photo-derived0.08–0.22m relief, not survey measurements. Existing opening shape and glass UVs remain unchanged.

Runtime glass is opaque and weakly emissive for WebGL2. The integrator adds offline coloured transparent shadow rays from the photoRGB and separately documented runtime lighting. This is not a spectral reconstruction.

Daylight exterior glass is a side-aware appearance approximation informed by qa_nativity_2026_08_09_cc0.jpg and qa_passion_close.jpg: linear base=sourceRGB*0.045+(0.012,0.018,0.022), emission0, roughness0.22, coat0.25, IOR1.5. Interior shader remains unchanged. This is not measured spectral transmission or exact exterior photography.

Historic Nativity weathering is an original procedural photographic estimate: warmer ochre-grey albedo, gentle low-frequency mottling, small mineral pits and restrained directional staining. Not a quarry scan or restoration-condition survey. Explicitly limited to old Nativity fabric by exterior geometry owner; new central towers retain existing materials.
Photographs document installed artwork at capture dates2014–2023, not current2026 construction state. Their exposure and illumination are retained, without a claim of recovered spectral albedo.

East source-photo left-to-right verified order is yellowgreen→palegreen→unimplemented Chartres/Lourdes bluegreen→MontAthos blue. Modeled X-order is blue→Ribeiro→palegreen→yellowgreen→yellowgreen. Ribeiro is an additional real bank with unresolved location, NOT asserted to be the missing Chartres/Lourdes artwork. Absolute bay assignment, spacing, repeat and upper-bank reuse remain approximate.
Apse and central clerestory remain original interpretations; this is not an exact entire-basilica artwork inventory.
MontAthos blue Mortel source: first two lower capsules meet the photograph edge; only visible glass is mapped. No visitor posters, invented continuation or cross-bank substitutions were added.

Palegreen atlas uses49 upper apertures from Mortel2016 and six complete lower capsules from the same bank in Meskens2016; source matches include Juan Sahagun inscription and distinct lower blue/green/red fields. Residual exposure difference is a photographic limitation.

process_stage_names.stone_pbr_web_v11: Base PBR profile name used by final deliverable V11.
process_stage_names.stone_finishes_v12: Internal construction-joint development stage; also included in final deliverable V11. It does not identify a separate released V12 artifact.

base_pbr.method: Deterministic periodic mineral-grain fields at fine and intermediate scales; distinct responses for sandstone, granite, basalt, porphyry, worked stone, vault, paving, concrete and older Nativity stone. No photographic sampling, purchased texture, generated repaint of a photograph or baked illumination. Original V10 maps remain preserved.

construction_finish.method: Original deterministic narrow joint masks, small per-block/section linear-albedo steps and roughness differences composed with the original web_v11 grain. Shallow height gradients combine with existing tangent normals. Image-based Principled inputs export to glTF; no runtime procedural Brick node is required. Source materials, mesh coordinates and existing UVs are not rewritten.

wall.layout: Six courses by three blocks in the existing 2m tile, alternate rows offset by half a block.

shaft.layout: Thin horizontal sections only. Regular vertical masonry lines are omitted because the existing dominant-axis UV projection would create false discontinuities.
shaft.appearance_note: Restrained section modulation chosen after actual Chrome review to keep the long lower shafts from reading as alternating stripes. Wall unit contrast remains stronger.

estimated_construction.measurement_status: All dimensions, colour variation, normal strength and roughness are visual estimates from photographs and appearance studies; none is a survey, quarry scan, profilometer/roughness measurement or measured spectral albedo.

final_application.wall_breakdown: 36 explicitly named wall/clerestory framing objects plus 10 side-bank stone-only meshes; broad window-band faces included.
final_application.source_allowlist: src/stone_finishes.py WALL_NAMES, SHAFT_PATTERN and WINDOW_STONE_PATTERN. Original V=z/2 UV scale checked before assignment.
final_application.side_window_face_limits: Area >=0.06m2, abs(normal.z)<0.25, abs(normal.y)>0.75; rose interior and fine ribs excluded.
final_application.excluded: Branches, capitals, vaults, roofs, floor, organic carved fabric, radial apse walls, fine rose ribs, upper clerestory glazing ensembles, every glass/photo material and all sculpture photographs. Original materials retain their assignments on excluded faces.
final_application.preserved: Mesh vertices, UVs, glass artwork, emission/material sidedness, sculpture images and source materials are unchanged by the stone finish operation.

colour_and_age_scope.no_global_aging: No uniform brown tint, global darkening, giant plaster-like cloud layer, painted cavity shadow or scene-wide ageing wash was added. Base profile keeps the V10 mean stone colours; local joint finish introduces small block/section differences only.
colour_and_age_scope.historic_nativity: Warm grey/ochre weathering remains limited to historic Nativity facade stone and its four older apostle towers. The new central towers and interior stone species keep their distinct material assignments.
colour_and_age_scope.microfinish: Honed/processed structural stone and rough worked stone retain different roughness and normal responses. These response values are estimates, not material measurements.
colour_and_age_scope.mean_colour_control: All six finish base-colour textures preserve the first candidate mean sRGB channel sums exactly; stronger local wall construction contrast does not globally darken or brown the model.

preservation_and_validation.original_source_integrity: 121 pre-existing texture/source hashes remained unchanged during construction-finish preparation and validation.
preservation_and_validation.photo_integrity: All 15 accepted embedded photographic assets match the frozen V10 SHA-256 values exactly. The other 54 embedded images are traced to original procedural PBR maps.
preservation_and_validation.visual_status: Final parameters incorporate actual Chrome review: stronger wall blocks, restrained shaft section modulation and thin joints. At this material-study stage, final rebuilt browser verification was still pending; SOURCE_RELEASE.json records the later source-packaging checks. CPU texture plates are not rendered views.
preservation_and_validation.first_candidate_snapshot: review_snapshots/stone_finish_first_candidate/: original construction-finish code, 18 PNGs, manifest and diagnostic plate preserved with FILE_HASHES.json.

nativity_local_variation.purpose: Restrain the uniformly sandy appearance of historic Nativity architectural stone with small neutral differences between existing modeled parts. This local revision preserves the earlier V11 PBR source images, photographed sculptures and glass.
nativity_local_variation.authorship: Original procedural derivatives of original V11 stone PBR; no photographic pixels.
nativity_local_variation.why_derived_images: The installed Blender5.2 glTF exporter clamps baseColorFactor to0..1. Four headroom maps allow both slightly lighter and darker copy materials using valid bounded factors, while retaining the original spatial grain and weathering pattern. They must be used with their calibrated material factors, not displayed unscaled.

derived_processing.base: Decode sRGB, multiply linear RGB by1.08, re-encode sRGB to8-bit PNG.
derived_processing.rough: Add0.03 to non-color roughness, clamp0..1 and encode8-bit PNG.
derived_processing.normal: Original normal image and shader strength reused unchanged.

scope.excluded: All photographic relief meshes including their stone returns; glass, bronze, mosaics, Passion, new towers, interior weather backing and all shared source material users outside these five collections.
scope.stone_parts: Whole connected authored leaves/knots and existing masonry components; each tower louvre uses12 angular sectors instead of one colour around a whole horizontal ring. Smooth regional variation is sampled by stone part; no dirt texture or random polygon-colour speckle is added.

appearance_estimates.balancing: Three levels are centered separately for each original stone using modeled mesh surface area. This maintains the average material linear RGB and roughness target; it is not a claim about screen-average luminance or actual measured facade reflectance.
appearance_estimates.normal: Original normal maps and strengths unchanged; no new geometric displacement, damage or invented cracks.
appearance_estimates.reference_status: Photo-informed interpretation of material differences, not a surveyed weathering map or measured material response. Previously catalogued exterior photographs are reference only for this procedural operation; no photograph pixels enter these four maps.

verification.glTF_material_probe: Six small CPU-exported probe faces preserve all six bounded baseColorFactor/roughnessFactor sets and original normal strengths; all three PBR texture inputs remain present.
verification.original_image_bytes: All four source base/rough PNG SHA-256 hashes match the frozen V11 profile. Original photographic assets, glass, normals and source textures are not edited.
verification.render_status: No GPU or render run by material author. Integration and actual Chrome appearance review are owned by root/QA.
